purpose: extend N2 implementation-level generality from arbitrary finite-discrete axis partitions to multiple ecological-state geometries without changing any frozen empirical endpoint
reference_measure_requirement: the richer and lower-information log scores must be evaluated on the same realized held-out state against the same reference measure; any common log-Jacobian/reference-measure term therefore cancels
proof_obligations: for each validated state space, the native primary gain equals the generic distributional gain on the same held-out values and weights within absolute tolerance 2e-10
for each validated state space, adding the same row-wise log reference-measure term to richer and baseline scores leaves the primary gain unchanged within absolute tolerance 2e-10
conflicting independent-group gains remain mixed regardless of observation-mass imbalance
all-positive independent-group gains are classified as generalizing
